dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺は寝るときに北枕を本気で気にする
　程のネガティブ野郎だったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, I'm the kind of negative person whose head always
points north when I sleep."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, I'm the kind of negative person whose head always
points north when I sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何なんですか、その嘘は……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ってなわけで、ひとっ走り行ってくる」
財布を尻ポケットに突っ込み、俺は家を出た。
dialogues.en:
Making sure that my wallet was in my bottom pocket, I headed
out.
dialogues.text:
Making sure that my wallet was in my bottom pocket, I headed
out.

dialogues.jp: 「よっしゃ。さくっと帰ろ」

刺身用のしょう油を手に、一転して我が家を目
指す。食事を途中で止めるのは、何か気持ち悪
い。
dialogues.en:
With a bottle of soy sauce in hand, I head back towards my
house. Leaving in the middle of a meal gives me a bad
feeling.
dialogues.text:
With a bottle of soy sauce in hand, I head back towards my
house. Leaving in the middle of a meal gives me a bad
feeling.

dialogues.jp:
閉店間際の｛にぎ／賑｝わいを見せる商店街の中、さくさ
くと人の間を縫っていく。
dialogues.en:
Several people were still mingling about the shopping
district, with most of the shops on the verge of closing for
the night.
dialogues.text:
Several people were still mingling about the shopping
district, with most of the shops on the verge of closing for
the night.

dialogues.jp:
気が急いていたのか、自分でも知らないうちに、
全力疾走になっていた。
dialogues.en:
Not giving much thought to those around me, I started
dashing towards home.
dialogues.text:
Not giving much thought to those around me, I started
dashing towards home.

dialogues.jp:
気が付いた時には、急には止まれない事にも気
が付いた。
dialogues.en:
Before I knew it, I had ran into a situation I couldn't
dodge.
dialogues.text:
Before I knew it, I had ran into a situation I couldn't
dodge.

dialogues.jp: ドンッ！
「うおっ」
「わっ！」

衝撃。続いて、何かが地面に落ちる音。俺は何
とか踏ん張り、しょう油も落とさなかった。
dialogues.en:
Impact. I heard the sound of something hitting the floor. I
managed to keep my balance and hold on to the soy sauce.
dialogues.text:
Impact. I heard the sound of something hitting the floor. I
managed to keep my balance and hold on to the soy sauce.

dialogues.jp: 「あっと、すいません。急いでて……」
dialogues.en: "Um, I'm sorry, I was in a hurry..."
dialogues.text: "Um, I'm sorry, I was in a hurry..."

dialogues.jp:
謝りつつ、地面の物を拾う。紙の袋に入った、
雑誌のような物だ。
dialogues.en:
I apologized quickly and started picking up the dropped
items. It was a paper bag full of magazines.
dialogues.text:
I apologized quickly and started picking up the dropped
items. It was a paper bag full of magazines.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、少年は老い易いからな。結構、結構」
「……何だ、暦先生か」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何だじゃないでしょうが。……って、うわっ」

しゅばっと、ソニックブームすら発生しそうな
素早さで、紙袋が奪い返された。
dialogues.en:
She quickly scrambled to grab the paper bag, possibly
creating a sonic boom in the process.
dialogues.text:
She quickly scrambled to grab the paper bag, possibly
creating a sonic boom in the process.

dialogues.jp:
落ちた衝撃だろう、口のところが開き、雑誌が
少しはみ出していた。
dialogues.en:
From the crash, I caught a quick glimpse of what was inside
the bag.
dialogues.text:
From the crash, I caught a quick glimpse of what was inside
the bag.

dialogues.jp: 「育児……通信？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや……ははは」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「…………？　どうしたんです？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやさあ、さ、最近、プリメっていうテレビ
　ゲームにはまっててね。こういうのが参考に
　なるかなと……」
dialogues.en:
"No, you see, recently, there's been this famous video game,
and I was referEncing this book..."
dialogues.text:
"No, you see, recently, there's been this famous video game,
and I was referEncing this book..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はあ……テレビゲーム？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そう！　朝倉もやるか？　｛せっけん／石拳｝４。私と」
dialogues.en:
"T, that's right! Do you want to try it with me? Sekken 4,
that is."
dialogues.text:
"T, that's right! Do you want to try it with me? Sekken 4,
that is."

dialogues.jp: ずずいっと迫ってくる。俺は及び腰になって、
dialogues.en: At her nervousness, I decide against it.
dialogues.text: At her nervousness, I decide against it.

dialogues.jp: 「い、いや、遠慮しとくっす」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。残念だなあ。ははは……」

暦先生はそそくさと雑誌を袋に押し込むと、しゅ
たっと片手を挙げた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei then raised one hand, with the other carrying
the paper bag suspiciously, like a burglar.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei then raised one hand, with the other carrying
the paper bag suspiciously, like a burglar.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、さいなら。気をつけて帰るんだよ」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。さよなら」

こつこつと、夜風に足音を運ばせて、暦先生は
足早に去っていった。
dialogues.en:
Her quick footsteps echoing into the distance before fading
away.
dialogues.text:
Her quick footsteps echoing into the distance before fading
away.

dialogues.jp: 「……何なんだ？」
「ただいま〜」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お帰りなさい」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……って、どうしたんです？　何か、げんな
　りした顔してますよ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや……ゲームには、攻略本ってのがあるっ
　て事を、教えた方がいいのかどうか悩んでい
　てな……」
dialogues.en:
"No... I'm just wondering what kind of game guide would have
a cover like that..."
dialogues.text:
"No... I'm just wondering what kind of game guide would have
a cover like that..."

dialogues.jp: 顔を見合わせ、首を傾げるふたりだった。
dialogues.en: We both tilted our necks in confusion.
dialogues.text: We both tilted our necks in confusion.

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生が育児通信？◆
やっぱり買いに行くことにした。
dialogues.en: In the end, I still went to buy it.
dialogues.text: In the end, I still went to buy it.

dialogues.jp:
その帰り道、暦先生と出会った。妙な雑誌を持っ
ていたが、何だったんだろうな？
dialogues.en:
On the way back, I literally bumped into Koyomi-sensei. What
kind of magazine was she carrying?
dialogues.text:
On the way back, I literally bumped into Koyomi-sensei. What
kind of magazine was she carrying?
